scope: Research-only image-source repair for standalone 365-day Calendar artwork review; no production app modification
diagnosis: Calendar candidate rows omitted image preview metadata even when archived Sacred Art source registry provided it. Artwork image source needs to be joined by physical_work_group or exact canonical ID, rather than treating all undefined thumbnail_url as genuine missing photographs.
corrective_viewer_policy: Join exact artwork and group IDs to pinned source metadata
Normalize archived thumb.wikimedia.org URLs to upload.wikimedia.org
When Commons imageinfo preview absent, use Special:Redirect/file with the exact Commons filename
For Metropolitan Museum use single-object Open Access API with the exact object ID to obtain primaryImageSmall
For Cleveland Museum use Open Access API exact Athena ID or accession and images.web.url
For unresolved images, open the official source record; do not fabricate a substitute or automatically approve visual fit
Support enlargement, neutral Reset and keep Phase 1 broad-fit decisions under the unchanged review revision key
